map.伤口愈合时间推算 使用指南: Wound Healing Time Estimation — User Guide
map.前臂 baseDays[10,18]×系数 0.95，切割伤 1.0 × 中 1: Forearm baseDays[10,18]×factor 0.95, incised wound 1.0 × medium 1.0 × youth 1.0 → lower 10×0.95≈9.5→10 days, upper 18×0.95≈17.1→…
map.按身体部位定基础时长：血供越丰富愈合越快：面部 5-10 天、头皮 7-14、躯: Base duration by body site—richer blood supply heals faster: face 5–10 days, scalp 7–14, trunk/limbs 10–25, lower leg/foot 14–30, joints 14–28; diabetic foot 30–90 days, deep tissue 21–42 days (each multiplied by a site factor).
map.按伤口类型与大小修正：类型系数：擦伤 0.7、手术切口 0.85、切割伤 1.0: Adjust by wound type and size: type factors—abrasion 0.7, surgical incision 0.85, incised 1.0, laceration 1.2, burn 1.3; size—small 0.75, medium 1.0, large 1.4 (multiplicative).
map.按年龄修正与阶段拆分：年龄系数：儿童 0.8、青年 1.0、中年 1.15、老年: Age adjustment and phase split: age factors—child 0.8, youth 1.0, middle-aged 1.15, elderly 1.35. Healing is shown in four phases: inflammatory (20%), proliferative (50%), epithelialization (lower bound), remodeling (upper bound).

map.算例 B：糖尿病足大伤口（老年、切割伤）: Example B: diabetic-foot large wound (elderly, incised)
map.必须严格控制血糖、每日检查足部、保持伤口清洁，任何伤口都建议尽早就医: Strictly control blood sugar, inspect feet daily, keep the wound clean; see a doctor early for any wound
map.出现红肿热痛、渗液、发热等感染迹象应及时就诊: Seek care promptly if signs of infection appear—redness, swelling, heat, pain, discharge, or fever
map.为什么糖尿病足愈合这么慢？: Why does a diabetic foot heal so slowly?
map.高血糖损害血管神经、降低局部血供与免疫力，组织修复能力显著下降，且易感染。必须严: High blood sugar damages vessels and nerves, lowers local blood supply and immunity, and markedly reduces tissue repair—and infections are easy. Strictly control blood sugar, inspect feet daily, keep the wound clean; see a doctor early for any wound.
map.清创止血、保持适度湿润清洁、均衡蛋白与维生素 C/Zinc 摄入、戒烟、控制基础: Debride and stop bleeding, keep a moderately moist and clean wound, balance protein and vitamin C/zinc intake, quit smoking, and manage underlying disease (blood sugar/blood supply). Seek care promptly for infection signs—redness, swelling, heat, pain, discharge, or fever.
